text:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: Elevated ECC correctable rates and Xid errors observed across clusters (us-west2, eu-west1). Prod GPU capacity dropped ~17% in the last 15m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1939012345 :rotating_light:
Alex: Saw the alert — tagging @oncall-sre. Any immediate customer impact? Which pools are hottest?
Maria: oncall here — yes impact on hosted-prod in eu-west1 and a few us-west racks. Seeing continuous Xid 13/31 and ECC correctables flooding. Correlates spatially with rack-gpu-22/23 and rack-gpu-12.
Maria: excerpt from node dmesg:
```
[ 238.412345] NVRM: Xid (13) at 0x1a2b3c: pid 2345 GPU exception
[ 238.412350] NVRM: RmAccessVa failed for 0x7f.., reason 0x4
[ 238.413000] ECC: corrected errors: 1023/sec on GPU 0
```
Sam: Hold all automatic firmware/driver rollouts until we root cause. @infra-lead we should open vendor escalation and prepare for coordinated drains + hardware swap.
monitoring-bot: Affected nodes (sample): gpu-224, gpu-225, gpu-227, gpu-512, gpu-514. Capacity metric: 82.6% -> 65.9% in last 20m.
Li: Starting staged drains on the most noisy nodes now. Command I'm running: `kubectl drain gpu-224 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` and reprovisioning from spare-pool-1.
Jason: FYI we've seen similar patterns where flaky PCIe risers or power distribution cause ECC surges. Requesting hardware-ops to validate riser temps and BMC logs. Pinging @dc-support.
Maria: Opening INC#2024-438 with vendor (NVIDIA partner). Putting required artifacts (dmesg, nvml logs, core dumps) in S3: s3://redwood-ops/gpu-incident/1939012345/ — shared with vendor.
Alex: Given customer SLAs, recommend temporarily bumping Dedicated burst capacity in impacted regions. Cost estimate ~ $2.5k/day for 48h. Approve?
Sam: Approve temporary burst. Also we need an ops plan: 1) stop rollouts, 2) drain affected racks, 3) hot-swap hardware where indicated, 4) vendor remote debug, 5) capacity burst to cover production. Schedule 2-hour maintenance window 03:00-05:00 UTC for hardware replacements.
oncall-sre: Drains completed for first wave (gpu-224/225/227). Early signs good — error rate down on those nodes but eu-west rack-12 still shows elevated ECC. Keeping non-prod batch jobs throttled.
monitoring-bot: Update 15m after drains — cluster error rate down ~43% vs peak, capacity recovered from 65.9% -> 74.8%. Continuing to monitor; keeping thread open until vendor confirms root cause. :white_check_mark:
